context: Operator response to whether manual remote-control walking works after SDK trials did not produce stepping.

host_control_snapshot.scope_limit: Snapshot of known processes and local ROS domain only; does not exclude other devices or onboard controllers.

robot_readonly_queries.interpretation_limit: Empty GetState data and service status integers are not proof that walking is ready. Native obstacle avoidance being enabled is not a confirmed cause.

native_lidar.interpretation_limit: Data reception does not validate obstacle classification or free space. Native sport range_obstacle zeros and raw lidar IMU/rotation fields have unverified semantics in this mode. The earlier native_lidar.json used local-platform DDS and cannot diagnose robot lidar availability.

remote_input_observation.interpretation_limit: No joystick input was recorded, but no operator push was confirmed during the window. This does not prove a defective joystick. Further input check was suspended for cooling.

latest_health_snapshot.interpretation_limit: Temperature is above the autonomous startup limit; this does not establish temperature as the original cause of no stepping.

software_validation.reason: No control-code change; physical walking failure is unresolved.

next_required_information: Unitree App alarm text or error code, including explicit no-alarm status.
Whether manual control causes body tilt without stepping, unstable foot lifting, or no response.
handover: Keep prone to cool. Suspend SDK walking trials. Do not increase speed, switch gait/mode, disable native avoidance, reboot or calibrate joints based on unconfirmed hypotheses. Obtain the operator symptom and App alarm details before deciding the next recovery action.
